biggest_catch: Only reimburses transfer fees you actually paid - it is a rebate of a cost, not free cash; and you must keep the account open 6+ months.
catches: Reimburses up to $100 of transfer fees charged by your OLD broker on ACAT transfers of $10,000+ - you only get back what you actually paid
Must submit the SogoTrade Account Transfer Reimbursement Request Form plus an account statement as proof (by mail or fax)
Account must stay open and maintain $500+ equity for at least 6 months, or SogoTrade may claw back the reimbursement credit
Not available for IRA accounts or for internal transfers between SogoTrade accounts
Offer can be terminated at any time without notice; 'valid for a limited time'
Reimbursement credited within 30 days of receipt of the form and statement

c1.evidence: SogoTrade (sogotrade.com) - US online broker, Member FINRA/SIPC (Apex Clearing). Official homepage 'CURRENT PROMOTIONS' section fetched 2026-09-23.

c2.evidence: Official terms: 'When you complete an account transfer, valued at $10,000 or higher, from another brokerage account to your SogoTrade account, SogoTrade will reimburse you, up to a maximum of $100, for the account transfer fees imposed by the other broker.' Reimbursement via account credit within 30 days of form + statement receipt.

c3.evidence: Concretely conditional: transfer $10k+ from another brokerage, submit reimbursement form with statement proof, keep account open with $500+ equity for 6 months. No trading required.

c4.evidence: No cost to claim; reimbursement offsets a real transfer fee. Not pay-to-play.

eligibility: New/existing SogoTrade brokerage clients completing an ACAT transfer of $10,000+ from another brokerage; IRAs and internal transfers excluded.
notes: G54 brokerage wave 2. Framed as a rebate of transfer fees (savings), not free cash. Not in catalog; prior brokerage wave covered other providers.

payout_value_note: Rebate of actual transfer fees paid to the old broker (up to $100); min $0 if the old broker charged no fee. Framed strictly as a cost reimbursement (savings), not income.

s1.note: Anyone transferring $10k+ from another brokerage to SogoTrade; IRAs excluded.

s2.note: Concrete: $10k+ ACAT transfer, reimbursement form + statement proof, 6-month $500+ hold.

s3.note: Credit to account within 30 days of receipt of form and statement.

steps: Complete an ACAT account transfer of $10,000 or more from another brokerage into your SogoTrade account
Fill out the SogoTrade Account Transfer Reimbursement Request Form and attach an account statement showing the transfer fee your old broker charged
Mail or fax the form and statement to SogoTrade
Keep the SogoTrade account open with at least $500 equity for 6 months
Receive the reimbursement (up to $100) as an account credit within 30 days of SogoTrade receiving the form
timing: Valid for a limited time per official terms (no end date listed); reimbursement credited within 30 days of form receipt.
